model.name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41 - Women's
model.description:
'

Faithful, reliable, and revolutionary, the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41 is unlike any other Peg that has ever been made before. Built with the same internal materials and padding as its predecessor, these running silhouettes are here to push the running world forward while still putting your wants and needs on top of the priority list. The two Zoom Air units combined with the Nike ReactX foam promise you a bouncy, springy sensation and an energised feel at toe-off. Interesting fact: the Nike ReactX foam is engineered to reduce carbon footprints by at least 43%, so you can take a stride towards a sustainable future. Whether you're logging long marathon miles or squeezing in a speed session before the sun goes down, you can put your faith in the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41‚Äîday after day, run after run.

Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41 features:

  • Engineered mesh upper feels lightweight and breathable.
  • Broadened forefoot and heel width leave space for the springy Zoom Air engine to deliver a cushioned ride.
  • Implemented midfoot band offers a more secure but forgiving sensation.
  • Midfoot strap provides a moulded fit that is shaped for all-sized arches.

Built for everything from easy miles to busy days on your feet, this pair delivers the light, cushioned ride runners love without feeling overly soft. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41 updates the trusted Peg formula with a breathable engineered mesh upper, dual Zoom Air units, and responsive ReactX foam for smooth comfort on runs, walks, and everyday wear.

  • Engineered mesh upper for lightweight breathability.
  • Dual Zoom Air units help add springy responsiveness.
  • ReactX foam provides soft, energized cushioning.
  • Broadened forefoot and heel create a stable platform.
  • Midfoot band and strap help secure the fit.

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers say the fit feels true to size and secure. For the best fit, we recommend starting with your usual size, or going up half a size if you prefer extra toe room, wear thicker socks, or want a little more space through the forefoot. Runners with narrow feet often like the locked-in feel.

Best For

Best for everyday training, treadmill sessions, walking, and all-day wear when you want one shoe that feels light, cushioned, and dependable.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently describe the ride as lightweight, bouncy, and supportive, with enough cushioning for distance without losing control of the road. It lands in a balanced sweet spot for runners who want shock absorption and smooth turnover instead of an overly high, ultra-soft feel.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers found them comfortable from the first wear, with little to no break-in needed. Over time, the upper and cushioning continue to feel supportive for regular runs, walking routines, and repeated miles.

"

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
